newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Faulding to end Olympus venture.
newsitem.headline: Faulding to end Olympus venture.

text.p: Pharmaceutical company F.H. Faulding and Co Ltd said its Faulding Imaging division would cease operations on Monday.

Faulding chief executive Ed Tweddell said Faulding Imaging, which represented Olympus Optical Co Ltd in relation to medical and industrial endoscopes and microscopes, had been successful but was restricted to Australia.

Tweddell said the closure would not have an impact on the group's 1996/97 profit nor on future growth prospects, and was in line with the company's focus on products and services which could be marketed throughout the world.
Olympus would now be establishing its own operation for endoscopes and microscopes in Australia, trading as Olympus Australia Pty Ltd, he said.
The statement said Olympus would take over assets from Faulding Imaging, but it did not reveal any financial details of the deal.
